title: Line sketch: Bloom Over Pagodas
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A vibrant chrysanthemum-like flower with falling petals dominates the upper center against a traditional East Asian ink wash landscape featuring misty mountains, pagodas, boats on a river, and forested shores. Dynamic black and white slash marks cut diagonally across the composition, creating a sharp contrast between the vivid floral element and the muted monochromatic background (derived from generated still #322).
